summary: The guide chapter fully complies with the brief, contextual boundaries, and primary source claims. It systematically covers the four required phases of supplier corrective actions: triggering SCARs directly from receiving nonconformance records, capturing root-cause analysis and objective containment evidence, reviewing proposed corrective actions with human review over automated summaries, and verifying post-implementation effectiveness before formal closure. All APG external providers guidance claims and ICC Supplier Quality module notes—including the pending status of portal-based tasking and mandatory human review of AI summaries—are accurately represented and properly qualified. Each section contains required workflow parameters (role, input, decision, record, exception), concrete software evaluation criteria, and a clearly labeled hypothetical example. No unassigned FAQ section is present.
recordNames: Controlled SCAR action plan approval record
decisions: Determine whether defect severity or recurring trend warrants issuing a formal SCAR to the external provider
Assess whether supplier containment actions and proposed root-cause determination are technically credible and sufficient
Approve proposed corrective action plan or mandate revision and resubmission
Determine whether corrective action demonstrated sustained recurrence prevention over agreed evaluation window
